title: About Me
content: I am the second employee and founding AI engineer at [ellamind](https://www.ellamind.com/), where I built [elluminate](https://elluminate.de/), a production LLM evaluation platform, from 0 → 1. I also reproduced popular evaluations on new models as well as designed custom evaluations targeting factual recall, multilingual capability, geographic reasoning, and multi-turn agentic performance. Previously I was a machine learning and software engineer at [QuantCo](https://www.quantco.com/) and began my career as a performance engineering intern at Facebook.
I hold a BSc and MEng in Computer Science from MIT (6-3) and maintain a strong focus on systems programming, performance engineering and, most recently, applied work with LLMs.
Outside of work I tinker on hobby programming projects and contribute upstream to open source projects. I stay curious by learning Polish, traveling Eastern Europe and dancing Kizomba.
